fact: On 2 June 2025 Agence Ecofin reported that BCEAO required payment service providers, including non-banks, to hold an approval by 31 August 2025 under Instruction 001-01-2024, and that one provider was approved in Niger as of 27 May 2025.
title: Services de paiement UMOA : les fintech ont jusqu'au 31 août pour se régulariser
